detailZh: 费尔南多·阿隆索在墨西哥城大奖赛前再次批评亚历克斯·阿尔本以及F1赛场上的其他车手
两届F1世界冠军费尔南多·阿隆索重申了他对威廉姆斯车手亚历克斯·阿尔本以及其他在F1队尾竞争的车手的批评；天空体育F1将直播墨西哥城大奖赛的各节练习与排位，周五练习赛时间为18:30和22:00
阿斯顿·马丁车手费尔南多·阿隆索对F1中排名后三分之一车手的天赋水平提出了尖锐批评
阿斯顿·马丁车手费尔南多·阿隆索在奥斯汀与威廉姆斯车手亚历克斯·阿尔本发生碰撞后，再次批评F1中部分“水平低”“缺乏天赋”的车手。
在美国大奖赛的首圈，阿尔本试图在第11号发夹弯超越阿隆索升至第12位，但撞上了阿斯顿·马丁车手的侧面，导致两辆车都受损。
两位车手都没有受到处罚，两人都得以继续比赛，最终在奥斯汀阿隆索获得第16名，阿尔本获得第17名。

赛后，阿隆索表示F1发车区后三分之一车手的质量“非常低”，在本周末墨西哥城大奖赛前的周四媒体日上，他并未改变自己的立场。
“我认为这纯粹是驾驶水平非常低，缺乏天赋，”他告诉天空体育F1。
“当你在整个赛季中反复犯错，发生撞车，且50%的比赛在第一圈就结束了，如果我是车队领队，我不会高兴，但如果他们高兴，我也没问题。”
“当我看到马克斯（维斯塔潘）、刘易斯（汉密尔顿）在更换引擎或其他原因后从后排起步时，还有基米在蒙扎，他们依然能赢下比赛。当你拥有自信和天赋，愿意再多等一两圈时，第一圈并不是世界末日。”
2026年美国大奖赛精彩集锦
阿隆索表示，他不会在周五的车手会议上提出这个问题，因为“这是比赛的一部分”，而且这取决于阿斯顿·马丁能否从更靠前的位置发车，从而“摆脱那个区域”。
“有些车队无法得分。今年对我们来说也是一样。你参加比赛时就知道，需要八次退赛才能得分，所以更重要的是跑出最好的比赛直到终点线，”他补充道。
"如果你赛季表现不佳，被队友击败，无论你脑子里在想什么，都会带来额外的挫败感，但其他车手和车队不应该为此付出代价。"
费尔南多·阿隆索在奥斯汀与亚历克斯·阿尔本发生碰撞后，批评了"低水平的后三分之一车手"
"听到这样的话不太好受"——阿尔本回应阿隆索的言论
阿尔本在国际汽联新闻发布会上得知了阿隆索的言论，并辩称目前的发车阵容"有一段时间"以来从未如此强大。
威廉姆斯车手表示：“我也要加倍坚持我之前的说法。我对费尔南多怀有极大的敬意。我小时候非常仰慕他。”
“从很多方面来说，听到那些评论并不好受。你正在和你仰慕的人比赛，但与此同时，我并不同意。就这么简单。”
“我认为发车区上下水平的实力都很强。我认为10年、15年前，发车区后半部分的状况和现在不一样。我们不再有付费车手了。事情就是这样。希望这个周末的比赛中我们不会在弯角或赛道上相遇！”
威廉姆斯车手亚历克斯·阿尔本不同意费尔南多·阿隆索关于一级方程式发车区后三分之一存在“缺乏天赋”的说法
不过，阿隆索指出，自从他2001年首次亮相F1以来，他的这些评论在他职业生涯的任何阶段都会是一样的。
“多年来都是如此。当你在发车区后排时，赛车很难驾驶，更难驾驶——它们抓地力更小，所以失误更频繁，因为你没有一个受控的环境，赛车也不会以友好的方式迎接你，所以你会犯更多错误。
“但我不觉得第一圈的所有事故和碰撞、飞来飞去的前翼，所有这些事情都是不必要的，尤其是当你在发车区后排毫无意义地争斗时，还有预算帽，让这个问题雪上加霜。
“有些车队对预算帽很满意，每场比赛都撞坏东西。他们付得起。”

detailEn: Fernando Alonso doubles down on Alex Albon and F1 field criticism ahead of Mexico City Grand Prix

Two-time F1 world champion Fernando Alonso has reiterated his criticism of Williams' Alex Albon and other drivers who battle at the back of the grid in F1; watch every session of the Mexico City GP with Friday's practice sessions at 6.30pm and 10pm, live on Sky Sports F1
Aston Martin's Fernando Alonso was scathing in his assessment of the talent level of the lower third of the Formula 1 grid
Aston Martin's Fernando Alonso has doubled down on his criticism of "low level" Formula 1 drivers who have a "lack of talent" following his collision with Williams' Alex Albon in Austin.
Albon tried to overtake Alonso for 12th place into the Turn 11 hairpin on the opening lap of the United States Grand Prix, but went into the side of the Aston Martin driver, damaging both cars.
Neither driver received a penalty and both were able to continue with Alonso finishing 16th and Albon in 17th in Austin.

Post-race, Alonso stated the quality of the drivers in the bottom third of F1's grid is "very low" and he had not changed his stance in Thursday's media day ahead of this weekend's Mexico City Grand Prix.
"I think it's simply a very low level of driving and lack of talent," he told Sky Sports F1.

"When you make repeated mistakes throughout the season and have crashes and 50 per cent of your race is in Lap 1, if I was the team principal I would not be happy but if they are happy, I'm OK with that.

"When I see Max [Verstappen], Lewis [Hamilton] starting at the back when they change the engine or whatever, Kimi in Monza, they still win the races. Lap 1 is not the end of the world when you have your confidence and the talent to wait for one or two more laps."
Highlights from the 2026 United States Grand Prix
Alonso says he will not bring up the issue in Friday's drivers' meeting as "it's part of the game" and it is down to Aston Martin to start higher up the grid to "get out of that part of the field".

"Some teams cannot score points. It's the same for us this year. You go into the races knowing you need eight DNFs to score points, so it's more about driving the best race to the finish line," he added.
"Probably if you're not having a good season, being beaten by your team-mate, whatever is in your head it brings extra frustration but other drivers and teams should not pay for that."
Fernando Alonso criticised 'low quality bottom third drivers' following his collision with Alex Albon in Austin
'Not nice to hear that' - Albon reacts to Alonso comments
Albon was told about Alonso's comments in the FIA press conference and argued the grid is as strong as it has been "for a while".
"I'll double down with what I said as well. I have a huge respect for Fernando. I looked up to him a lot growing up as a kid," said the Williams driver.
"It's not nice to hear those comments in many ways. You're racing someone that you look up to, but at the same time, I don't agree. It's as simple as that.

"I think level is strong up and down the grid. I think 10, 15 years ago, the back half the grid wasn't the way it is now. We don't have pay drivers anymore. It is what it is. Hopefully, we don't cross corners or cross paths in the race this weekend!"
Williams driver Alex Albon disagrees with Fernando Alonso's assertion that there's a 'lack of talent' in the lower third of the Formula 1 grid
However, Alonso had pointed out his comments would be the same at any point in his career since he made his F1 debut in 2001.

"It's the same over the years. When you are at the back of the grid, the cars are difficult to drive, more difficult to drive - they have less grip so mistakes are coming more often because you don't have an environment which is under control and the car is not welcoming you in a nice way, so you make more mistakes.

"But I don't feel all the incidents in Lap 1 and the touches, the front wings that fly around, all these things are not necessary, especially when you are fighting for nothing at the back of the grid and there is the cost cap, adding to this problem.
"There are teams that are happy with the cost cap and breaking things every race. They can pay for them."

迈凯伦的奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里位列第四，而红牛似乎已退出杆位争夺，马克斯·维斯塔潘落后领先圈速0.351秒，但周六晚9点（晚8点开始预热）的天空体育F1直播排位赛前，前排似乎确实有三支车队在争夺。
无论维斯塔潘在排位赛中表现如何，他都不能从杆位起步，因为他和小红牛车队的利亚姆·劳森因周五第二节练习中相撞而被罚退一个发车位。
赛会干事称该事件“不可接受”，两位车手都承认这次碰撞“没有必要且笨拙”。
在墨西哥城大奖赛第二节自由练习中，小红牛的利亚姆·劳森与红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘发生接触，这次碰撞最终导致两位车手都收到发车位罚单。
周六最后一节练习赛前又发生了更多戏剧性事件，哈斯车队做出令人震惊的决定，用替补车手平川亮替换埃斯特班·奥康，参加本周末剩余的比赛。
车队没有给出替换奥康的原因，但确认这位法国车手并未患病。
哈斯最近确认，奥康将在本赛季结束后离开车队，他在美国老板旗下的这支车队效力了两年，巴西年轻车手拉斐尔·卡马拉已签约作为他的替代者。
勒芒24小时耐力赛冠军平川亮在过去两年中多次参加哈斯车队的练习环节，在最后一次练习中排名第19，落后队友奥利弗·贝尔曼0.6秒。
埃斯特班·奥康通过车队无线电质疑哈斯车队在墨西哥城第二节练习中更改其运行计划的做法。

detailEn: Mexico City GP: Lando Norris pips Kimi Antonelli in final practice to set up thrilling Mexico qualifying

Lando Norris and Kimi Antonelli were separated by just 0.001s at the top of the timesheet in final practice for the Mexico City Grand Prix; watch qualifying later at 9pm with Sunday's race at 8pm (build-up from 6.30pm), live on Sky Sports F1

Sky Sports F1's David Croft and Karun Chandok discuss Esteban Ocon being replaced by Haas for the Mexico City GP, Liam Lawson and Max Verstappen being handed a grid penalty for their P2 collision and Isack Hajar's paddock altercation with a fan
McLaren's Lando Norris pipped Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli by 0.001s in final practice for the Mexico City Grand Prix to set up a thrilling qualifying.
Ferrari's Charles Leclerc had topped both of Friday's practice sessions but McLaren and Mercedes showed their hand to outpace the Monegasque driver by one tenth of a second.
Antonelli is likely to become world champion in Sunday's race as he only needs a top-nine finish to secure the Formula 1 drivers' title.

McLaren's Oscar Piastri was fourth while Red Bull appear to be out of the pole position battle as Max Verstappen was 0.351s off the pace, but there seems to be a genuine three-team fight at the front for qualifying later on Saturday at 9pm (build-up from 8pm), live on Sky Sports F1.
Regardless of what he does in qualifying, Verstappen cannot start on pole position as he and Racing Bulls' Liam Lawson have a one-grid place penalty for colliding in second practice on Friday.
The stewards called the incident "unacceptable", with both drivers admitting the clash was "unnecessary and clumsy".
Racing Bulls' Liam Lawson and Red Bull's Max Verstappen make contact during FP2 at the Mexico City GP - the clash would eventually lead to both drivers receiving a grid penalty
More drama took place before final practice on Saturday as Haas made the shock decision to replace Esteban Ocon with reserve driver Ryo Hirakawa for the remainder of the weekend.
The team provided no reason for replacing Ocon, but confirmed the Frenchman was not suffering from illness.
Haas recently confirmed that Ocon will be leaving the team at the end of this season after two years with the American-owned squad, with Brazilian youngster Rafael Camara signed as his replacement.
Hirakwa, a 24 Hours of Le Mans winner, has taken part in several practice sessions for Haas over the last two years and was 19th in final practice, six tenths down on team-mate Oliver Bearman.

detailZh: 埃斯特班·奥康：哈斯在墨西哥城大奖赛周末剩余赛程中由平川亮接替这位法国车手，未提供原因
埃斯特班·奥康将不再参加墨西哥城大奖赛余下环节，哈斯由平川亮接替这位法国车手；哈斯未说明换下奥康的原因；奥康将在本赛季结束后离开车队
埃斯特班·奥康已在哈斯被平川亮接替，参加墨西哥城大奖赛剩余赛程。
车队未说明换下奥康的原因，但确认这位法国车手并非患病。
奥康在第二次练习赛后以第13名完赛，在车队无线电中发泄了自己的不满，并且将不再参加本站比赛的任何环节，因为平川亮将在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道顶替他的发车位。
奥康质疑了车队在周五第二次练习赛中让他使用中性胎而非软胎的决定。
这位法国车手在被赛事工程师劳拉·穆勒告知其驾驶计划有变后，恳求道“别这样对我”。
哈斯车队最近确认，奥康将在本赛季结束后离开这支美国所有的车队，他已在队效力两年。
车队声明写道：“TGR哈斯F1车队储备车手平川亮将在本周末墨西哥城大奖赛的剩余赛程中替换埃斯特班·奥康，时间为10月31日星期六至11月1日星期日。”
“平川亮（32岁）曾随丰田GAZOO Racing两度赢得国际汽联世界耐力锦标赛冠军（2022年、2023年），并夺得勒芒24小时耐力赛冠军（2022年）。他于10月30日星期五在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道参加了第一节自由练习，这是他本赛季第三次驾驶VF-26赛车出战自由练习，最终位列全场第15名。”
“这位日本车手将在星期六的第三节自由练习和排位赛以及星期日的71圈大奖赛中与队友奥利·贝尔曼搭档——这将是平川亮的F1正赛首秀。”

detailEn: Esteban Ocon: Haas replace French driver with Ryo Hirakawa for remainder of Mexico City GP weekend without providing reason

Esteban Ocon will take no further part in the Mexico City GP, with Haas replacing French driver with Ryo Hirakawa; Haas gave no reason for Ocon's replacement; Ocon is leaving the team at the end of the season
Esteban Ocon has been replaced by Ryo Hirakawa at Haas for the remainder of the Mexico City Grand Prix.
The team provided no reason for replacing Ocon, but confirmed the Frenchman was not suffering from illness.

Ocon vented his frustrations on the team radio while finishing 13th following second practice and will take no further part in the race as Hirakawa will take his place on the grid at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodríguez.
Ocon questioned the team's decision to run him on the medium rather than soft tyre during second practice on Friday.
The Frenchman pleaded "don't do this to me" to his race engineer Laura Mueller after being informed of a change to his run-plan.
Haas recently confirmed that Ocon will be leaving the team at the end of this season after two years with the American-owned squad.
A team statement read: "TGR Haas F1 Team reserve driver Ryō Hirakawa will replace Esteban Ocon for the remainder of the weekend's Mexico City Grand Prix, Saturday 31 October - Sunday 1 November.

"Hirakawa (32), a two-time winner of the FIA World Endurance Championship (2022, 2023) and 24 Hours of Le Mans Winner (2022) with Toyota GAZOO Racing, participated in FP1 at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez on Friday 30 October - his third free practice outing of the season driving the VF-26, finishing 15th overall.
"The Japanese driver will partner teammate Ollie Bearman through final practice and qualifying on Saturday and Sunday's 71-lap grand prix - Hirakawa's Formula 1 race debut."
